sql: SELECT disease, mmwr_year, mmwr_week, reporting_area, cumulative_ytd_current_year, cumulative_ytd_current_year_flag FROM health.cdc_nndss_weekly WHERE disease ILIKE 'Measles%' AND mmwr_year='2026' AND UPPER(reporting_area) IN ('US RESIDENTS','TOTAL','UNITED STATES','U.S. RESIDENTS','NEW YORK','PENNSYLVANIA') ORDER BY mmwr_week DESC FETCH FIRST 20 ROWS ONLY

SELECT mmwr_week, cumulative_ytd_current_year FROM health.cdc_nndss_weekly WHERE disease='Measles, Indigenous' AND mmwr_year='2026' AND reporting_area='Total' ORDER BY CAST(mmwr_week AS INT) DESC FETCH FIRST 3 ROWS ONLY

SELECT disease, SUM(CAST(cumulative_ytd_current_year AS DOUBLE)) AS v, COUNT(*) AS n FROM health.cdc_nndss_weekly WHERE disease LIKE 'Measles%' AND mmwr_year='2026' AND mmwr_week='43' AND reporting_area NOT IN ('Total','U.S. Residents') AND cumulative_ytd_current_year>0 GROUP BY disease
